Academic institutions in developing economies face an intricate paradigm shift. While traditional education models prioritized rote learning and standardized metrics, contemporary global standards demand a transition toward critical inquiry, interdisciplinary research, and digital adaptability. However, this transition is hampered by constrained infrastructure, inadequate institutional funding, and policy misalignment. options: A complete cessation of all higher education funding.
An absolute drop in student enrollment rates across all departments.
Producing graduates whose capabilities do not align with market realities.
